title: Provider Quota config
description: Plugin config persisted under plugins['quota'].* in ~/.pi/dashboard/config.json. Read by the server entry. Installing the plugin IS the opt-in, so tracking defaults ON for every provider EXCEPT anthropic, which stays OFF until the user ticks it (its endpoint is the ToS-sensitive one).

enabled.description: Master gate. When false the server entry makes no subscription-quota endpoint call and /api/quota returns no providers.

providers.description: Per-provider enablement, keyed by provider id. Defaults ON for every provider EXCEPT anthropic: its /api/oauth/usage endpoint is the ToS-sensitive one, so it requires an explicit tick.

retry.description: In-request retry of a TRANSIENT quota-fetch failure (HTTP 429/5xx, timeout, network) with expanding backoff. Off by default. Every numeric field is also clamped on read, so a malformed persisted value can never drive an unbounded wait or a timer overflow.

enabled.description: Master gate for retry. When false the server makes exactly one attempt per provider.

maxAttempts.description: Retries AFTER the initial attempt (0 disables retry). The initial attempt always runs, so the worst-case attempt count is maxAttempts + 1.

baseDelayMs.description: First backoff delay in ms; doubles each retry, capped at maxDelayMs.

maxDelayMs.description: Ceiling for a single backoff delay in ms.
